notes.title: Patch Notes Recap (v0.17.1 to v0.19.0)
notes.notes:
Patch 0.17.1
UI
Added a “loading” animation when looking for a game to avoid confusion of the client being frozen. 

VFX
World’s on Fire. Added Summon VFX.

BALANCE
Vokorath 9/9>10/10
Suicide Grunt Cost 1>2
Leather Chest Use 1>2
Blazing Imp Damage 3>1
Front Line Sentinel Cost 2>3
Curious Archivist HP 3>2
World’s on Fire Damage 2>3

BUGS
Added a check on player connections and game start to help prevent empty rooms. 
(Still monitoring this since it happened sporadically. If it happens to you, please report!)


v0.18.0
GAMEPLAY
If no online opponent is found after a short wait, you’ll now be matched against an AI opponent to help keep queue times low and let you test decks. 

UI
Added arrows on cursor when changing page on deckbuilder. 
Removed "Only" toggle filters on deckbuilder. 

BALANCE
Blood Pact Cost 3>4

BUGS
Fixed Demonic Hatchery Summon VFX on top of card. 
Fixed a bug where green outlines reappeared on idle creatures at the end of turn, incorrectly showing up during the opponent’s turn.
Predator’s Carapace. Fixed card description.
Crytal Ball’s. Fixed card description. 


v0.19.0
SFX/VFX 
Fire Projectiles Audio and VFX Updates
Healing Projectiles Audio and VFX Updates
Elder Treant. New Summon SFX
Lyra’s Passive Audio and VFX Updates
Hexbound Seer Summon Audio Updates
Ramper Summon Audio Updates
Added Victory and Defeat Audio Cues

GAMEPLAY
Keyword: Can not attack heroes > Restrained

CARD NAME UPDATES
Flanker > Sylvan Flanker
Scouter > Sylvan Sentry
Drow Woodelf > Gloom Stalker
Shadow Tree > Penumbra Oak
Volley > Final Volley
Caltrops > Living Vines
Great Oak > Timber Hulk
Little Bad Guy>Cursed Puppet
Pinger > Infernal Ghoul
Lethal Striker > Festering Son
Fiery Demon > Flame Fiend
Hellfire Hwacha Description Updated. 

BUGS
-Fixed a bug where a burned Ramper would die and give full mana on the same turn. All Start of Turn keywords are now  processed after energy refill. 
-Fixed a bug where drawing demon cards with Hellguard on the board was not instantly refreshing the newly drawn card’s cost.
-Fixed a bug where Quickload Gauntlets would reload bows while they were being fired, preventing the gauntlets from recognizing the bow as empty and granting the bonus arrow.
-Fixed a bugged interaction where Ring of Arcane Echoes would trigger more than once before destroying itself when receiving non-combat damage more than once in short periods of time.
-Fixed an issue where, at the end of turn, if creatures didn’t attack, their outlines would re-enable incorrectly at the start of the opponent’s turn.
